rationale: Chicken essence reduced some task-induced fatigue measures in healthy adults. Soup and extract comparisons for routine fatigue were inconclusive. In a restricted fried-chicken-and-pasta diet case, symptoms resolved after vitamin C treatment for scurvy, leaving no isolated chicken effect. The direction for poached chicken and Parkinson fatigue remains unresolved.

The oral dried-pepper crossover did not establish a sustained-attention difference. An Alzheimer mixture reports concentration changes without a verified between-arm item. Separate animal reports use concentrated pepper extracts, combinations or oil and measure memory or spatial attention. The oil paper has unresolved comparator provenance. New blend protocols do not have posted results. The direction for cracked pepper and attention impairment in Parkinson disease remains unresolved.
